description:
Export the complete list of Employee Hosts from Jolly Lobby Track to a CSV file. 

1. Navigate to the Employee/Host management section (often labeled 'Employee Center', 'Host List', or similar).
2. Find the Export function.
3. Export all records to a CSV file named 'employee_roster.csv'.
4. Save the file to the Documents folder ('~/Documents/employee_roster.csv' or 'My Documents\employee_roster.csv').
